about: The fixed inputs of the security tests: published test vectors and the passwords whose content is what a test checks (password policy, Unicode normalisation, the differential test of tools/rest-diff). The tests read this file when they run, so that no password, key or salt is written in their sources; every other test password is drawn at random when the tests run.

hmacSha256.data: what do ya want for nothing?

totp.source: RFC 6238 appendix B and RFC 4226 appendix D (HMAC-SHA-1 seed)

argon2id.source: the test vector of the Argon2 reference implementation (phc-winner-argon2): argon2id, v=19, t=2, m=65536, p=1

nfc.about: One password in NFC and NFD (precomposed e-acute against e + combining acute accent)

passwords.about: Passwords of the policy tests (crates/server/src/security/password/policy.rs, with the user name Magnus_C and the address grandpatzer@example.com) and of the registration steps of tools/rest-diff
